ambiguity: Gear lists a Shield and a Two-Handed Shortbow with no arrows. Does the goblin lose its Shield AC when it shoots, and does it use up ammunition?
ruling: Stat-block actions and AC are used exactly as printed. The goblin keeps AC 15 while using the Shortbow, and a monster's stat-block ranged attacks don't track ammunition.
note: Stat-block actions and AC are used as printed; monsters don't track ammunition.
